blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Corporate & Investment Banking — digital workers, decision hubs and self-healing workflows — governed autonomy at enterprise scale applied to the corporate & investment banking operating unit of Banking & Financial Services.

CIB margins compress while deal complexity grows: origination research, credit memos, trade documentation and risk reporting all consume expensive analyst hours that agentic systems can compress — with the control discipline investment banks cannot compromise.

items: LCs, trade documents and settlement instructions fail on reference mismatches; exception queues run through time zones.
Pitch books, credit memos and research notes re-type data from terminals and filings; quality varies by analyst stamina.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Process & Task Mining, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration, Intelligent Document Processing from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Credit memo production, Trade document handling, Intraday risk aggregation) on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Basel capital regimes among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: One automation spine — APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.
Self-healing workflows — long-running business processes that adapt, retry and recover without tickets.
Agents that execute the work — tool-using, policy-bounded, and replayable for audit.
reference mismatches detected and remediated with counterparty comms (STP up 25-40 points)
